question: Copper is used in _______ due to its low resistivity.
solution:
The correct answer is __**transmission lines**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Copper is a metal. Metals have the following properties:

__
 
• Conductivity:

 
 
• The property to carry heat and electricity is called conductivity.
 
• Metals are good conductors of heat and electricity, they are used to make electrical wires and cooking utensils.
 
• Metals can absorb heat very easily.
 
 
 
• Ductility:
 
 
• The property of metal to be drawn into wires is called ductility.
 
• Metals such as copper are used to make wires.
 
 
 
• Sonority:
 
 
• Metals make sounds when they hit a solid surface or hit each other. This property of metals is known as sonority.
 
• For their sonorous nature, metals are used in bell, etc.
 
 
 
• Malleability:
 
 
• ​The property of metals to be beaten into thin sheets is known as malleability.
 
• Metals such as gold, aluminium are highly malleable and can be beaten into thin sheets.
 
• They are opaque and are denser than other elemental substances.
 
 

Explanation:__

 
• Copper is a reddish-brown metal that has excellent conducting properties and ductility.
 
• As copper is ductile, It is used to make thin wires.
 
• Copper wiring is thus used in all electrical appliances.
 
• Copper is also shiny or lustrous in appearance and sonorous.
 
• It is also used in a number of alloys to obtain desirable properties.
 
• It is also used to make coins, bells etc.
 
• Copper is also used in roofing or plumbing.
